newsitem.title: SWITZERLAND: Trade in Jelmoli, Fust suspended.
newsitem.headline: Trade in Jelmoli, Fust suspended.

text.p: Trading in the shares of Jelmoli Holding AG and Dipl. Ing Fust AG have been suspended from trading on the Swiss Exchange the entire day, a bourse spokesman said.
Trading was suspended in the light of changes to the companies' share structure, he added.
Fust will be holding a news conference in Zurich at 1000 GMT.

Earlier today, Basler Handelsgesellschaft AG (BHG) and its unit trading company UTC International AG announced they would sell their stake in Swiss retailer Jelmoli to Fust for around 270 million Swiss francs, a premium of more than 30 percent above the share price last quoted.
BHG/UTC said this sale would allow them to fulfill all their bank obligations and also raise money that can be used to further expand international activities.
